high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media comment section. The main focus is on a comment by a user named "wendi_elle_jae," who appears to be a teacher at an inner city school that has recently become an International Baccalaureate (IB) school. The comment discusses the challenges faced by schools, particularly Title 1 schools, which often serve low-income communities. The user expresses frustration with the general public's lack of understanding about what goes on in schools and the tendency to blame the school systems for issues.
